reason: Joins the two images of the strip into one text block and corrects minim and abbreviation readings (uiris, conseruis, nec, sapientia) after comparison with a breviary witness and the edition.
sources: Jerome, Commentarii in Matthaeum III, on Mt 18:23-35 (PL 26), text via Corpus Corporum: https://mlat.uzh.ch/
text:
F-67mf - source-assisted reading of the lower strip (Iv and IIr), 20 October 2026
Reader: a research reader (Claude), after comparison with BnF lat. 17991 f. 147v-148r (page images) and Jerome, In Matthaeum III (PL 26, via Corpus Corporum). Not reviewed by a person.
Basis: native-resolution crops of canvas 0 (StAL_B_114_Bd_6823_Iv_IIr_links, box 3550,4950,2600,1450) and canvas 1 (StAL_B_114_Bd_6823_IIr_rechts, box 650,4330,3150,1400), unrotated. Image-only base: batch-2026-10-17-image-only (image-001 upper strip, image-003 upper strip).
Changes against the base: the right text block of image-001 and the strip of image-003 are one text block; each image-001 line beginning is followed by the image-003 line of the same row. "iuris" read "uiris"; "conseruus" read "conseruis"; "n(on)" before "a prudentibus" and before "ecclesiastice" read "n(ec)"; "Sic" may be Sic(ut); line 7 of the left block "[ar]matura(m) dei"; the word under the threads in line 2 "sapi(enti)a". Text in [ ] is lost; | marks the join between the two images.
